queer_characters.name: Mark Ashton
queer_characters.notes: LGSM founder depicted as gay; historical figure who dies of AIDS at 26 as part of the true story.

queer_characters.name: Jonathan Blake
queer_characters.notes: Historical figure, one of the first diagnosed with HIV in the UK; portrayed as an active LGSM member.

queer_characters.name: Gethin Roberts
queer_characters.notes: Welsh activist and Jonathan's partner; a committed queer relationship shown within the group.

queer_characters.name: Joe Cooper
queer_characters.notes: 20-year-old closeted gay student whose arc is described in the source as part of the LGSM group.

queer_characters.name: Stephanie Chambers
queer_characters.notes: Described as the group's sole lesbian founder, providing lesbian representation within LGSM.
